purpose: Data provenance manifest for PaceAI research evaluation. Documents for every data artifact used in the project: what it is, where it came from, whether it is real or synthetic, whether individual consent for AI-processing exists, and whether it is usable as research-grade ground truth.
consent_policy: Any real human-recording dataset (video, physiological, or player-season) that lacks documented individual consent for AI/biomechanics analysis is recorded as consent_status: unknown. Unknown consent blocks use in published research or commercial deployment until consent can be established.

datasets.origin: Provided externally to the project; original source, capture protocol, camera specs and player identities not documented in-repo.
datasets.notes: 8 clips were run through the pipeline during PARI-F1 (May 2025 FFC qualifying sweep). No per-delivery biomechanical ground-truth labels exist for any clip; do not use for MAE/RMSE/ICC/Bland-Altman validation until labeled.
Used to train sports_injury_* bundles with StratifiedGroupKFold on athlete_id (no athlete leakage). Original citation/URL to be recorded on verification.

datasets.origin: Referenced in src/cricket_injury_data.py as 'Cricket Injury Dataset' (player-season level). Original source repository not documented in-repo.
datasets.notes: Used to train cricket_injury_* and cricket_severity_* bundles. ROC-AUC ~0.5 (player-season metadata only, genuinely hard task).

datasets.origin: Cricket-ball detection/classification image dataset used for ball tracking evaluation.
datasets.notes: BallAnnotation/PoseAnnotation evaluation harness exists (evaluation/evaluate.py) but annotation records are currently empty (NO_DATA).

datasets.origin: Generated in-repo by src/synthetic_data.py (rules grounded in literature-informed ranges; see CITATION.md).
datasets.notes: Labels derived from features (self-referential). Metrics on this set measure fit to the generator only -- never presented as accuracy.

datasets.origin: Generated in-repo by scripts/gen_gt_clips.py (synthetic ball-tracking clips with synthetic ball GT JSON).
datasets.notes: Synthetic ball-tracking ground truth only -- NOT human biomechanics ground truth.

datasets.origin: Compiled in-repo from fast-bowling epidemiology/biomechanics literature reviews (screening reference).
datasets.notes: Individual figures marked [Source verification required] in CITATION.md.

datasets.origin: SQLite history produced by app.py sessions.
datasets.notes: Local app state; not a research dataset.

model_bundles.origin: Produced in-repo by scripts/train_demo_model.py and scripts/train_sports_injury_model.py.
model_bundles.tagging: Each bundle carries data_source (synthetic/real), CV metrics, baseline comparison, training config, seed.
model_bundles.note: performance_random_forest/performance_xgboost/performance_catboost/performance_cnn_lstm/performance_transformer are DEMO models trained on synthetic_bowling_dataset (self-referential target). injury_* are DEMO biomechanical risk-indicator models (same synthetic set). sports_injury_* and cricket_injury_*/cricket_severity_* are trained on real labeled datasets with grouped cross-validation.

known_gaps: No human per-delivery biomechanical ground truth exists (P1 blocker for accuracy validation).
Consent status unknown for corrected_all_data and both tabular real datasets.
Original source citations/URLs for the two tabular real datasets not recorded in-repo.
